signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: The same account as on yomizaka.com.

library.title: Library
library.lead: Your documents stay in the folders of your Mac. Only what a check needs is sent, then erased.
library.emptyFolders: No folder yet. Pick the one where you keep your leases and contracts.
library.emptyFolder: No document a check reads in this folder (PDF, text, Word, OpenDocument).
library.drop: Drop your documents to check them
library.dropHint: From Finder, without adding them to a folder. Several documents make a batch.
library.folderDenied: This folder cannot be added: it is too broad or protected.
library.watchHint: A document added to this folder is checked as soon as it arrives. Those already there are not sent.

check.readFailed: The file could not be read.
check.paywall: This check is not available with your account right now.
check.feature: Batches are not open on your account.

batch.title: Batches
batch.lead: Several documents checked at once: a folder, or the documents dropped together.
batch.empty: No batch yet. Drop several documents, or check a whole folder.
batch.refusedHere: {count} document(s) stayed on this Mac: unreadable or refused by the pre-flight.

reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: The documents checked and their signed reports. The files themselves stayed on your Mac.

report.saved: Report saved next to the document: {name}
report.failed: The report could not be saved.

settings.title: Settings
settings.storageBody: Your documents are read from your folders and never leave them. For a copy in the cloud, choose it on yomizaka.com.
